articles.title: Brazilian companies turned to stablecoins on election day to dodge a currency crash
articles.snippet: USDT volume on crypto exchange Mercado Bitcoin jumped nearly 800% and bitcoin volume surged 865%. Binance’s USDT/BRL market tripled while the global BTC/USDT pair fell.

articles.title: Bitcoin miners' move into AI is creating a new market for trading computing power
articles.snippet: Luxor raised $16 million to expand into AI hardware and trading, betting that computing power will become a market where companies can hedge costs and prices.

articles.title: An AI label alone no longer wins lenders, JPMorgan says
articles.snippet: As default insurance on several AI-linked firms hits record costs, companies must show they can finance investment, service the debt and eventually mint cash, JPMorgan says.

articles.title: Ripple gets a final go-ahead to launch its own U.S. national trust bank
articles.snippet: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency has approved Ripple National Trust Bank (RNTB), Ripple's CEO Brad Garlinghouse announced on X.

articles.title: Intel, IBM, Oracle and IonQ latest to object to OKX-ICE tokenized stocks
articles.snippet: More than 40% of the companies initially proposed to have their stocks listed in tokenized form have asked to opt-out.
